misc: Has calmed down markedly after becoming a father
Adopted a L.A.B. Golf zero torque putter for the 2025 season
biography: Simo occupies a legendary and formidable position within the illustrious lineage of the Hector Trophée, bringing his exceptional golfing talents from the immaculate fairways of Hirsala Golf to the esteemed pair competition across eleven distinct editions. Long recognized among his peers for a fiercely expressive vocabulary on the links, this dedicated competitor was once infamous for unleashing a torrent of colorful profanity whenever a stray approach shot missed its intended target. However, following the profound life-changing experience of becoming a father, Simo has undergone a remarkable transformation, calming down markedly and replacing his fiery outbursts with a serene, composed demeanor.

Beyond his newfound tranquility on the course, Simo has etched his name permanently into the tournament's record books through truly sensational competitive achievements. He has tasted the ultimate glory of lifting the coveted Hector Trophée on four separate occasions, cementing his status among the most successful champions in the history of the event. Always seeking to refine his craft, he notably adopted a L.A.B. Golf zero torque putter for the 2025 season to further enhance his performance on the greens. While the individual accolades represented by the Victor Trophy have thus far remained outside his personal collection, his ongoing involvement in the vibrant community surrounding the tournament ensures that his compelling competitive journey remains fully active, leaving admirers in eager anticipation of his next masterclass.
